3755-4770-6090-7730.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

618-4681-6798.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide with haste.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2232-7827-7828-7836.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7828-7836.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

129-1409-3499-4289.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

215-1376-6968.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-1376-6968.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

413-3249-4647-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Shambling Ghast enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

1368-1563-5295-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-5295-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1308-1558-1671-2638-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1308-1558-1671-2638-4231.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Anointed Procession.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3259-7296--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-7296--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

2464-3713-5078-6766.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-3713-5078-6766.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

5147-5170-5933-6132.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3330-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3330-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

549-1061-4231-5469-6727.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Transmutation Font's first ability by tapping it, creating a Food, a Clue and a Treasure token.
Activate Kuldotha Forgemaster by tapping it, sacrificing the Food, the Clue and the Treasure, putting Timestream Navigator from your library onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

643-3129-3951-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
643-3129-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

4067-5116-6072-6281.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Graveshifter.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Graveshifter that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Graveshifter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

2724-3080-4013-4608.manaNeeded: {3}{C}{U}{U} the first turn with {2}{C} each extra turn
2724-3080-4013-4608.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
2724-3080-4013-4608.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

969-2034-2820-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

215-225-729-2404.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other creatures.
215-225-729-2404.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Oak Guardian to your hand.
Cast Great Oak Guardian by paying {5}{G}.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers itself, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more creatures, this combo will net infinite green mana, which you then may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant any number of times.

261-1462-2232-2413-2768.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 8.
You have not cast a spell using Demon of Fate's Design's ability this turn.
You control at least seven nontoken creatures.
261-1462-2232-2413-2768.description:
Cast Day of the Dragons by paying 7 life due to Demon of Fate's Design.
When Day of the Dragons enters the battlefield, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Day of the Dragons trigger, exiling all creatures you control and creating that many 5/5 Dragon creature tokens.
When the Dragon(s) enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times.
Resolve all but one Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the final Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Day of the Dragons to your hand from the battlefield.
When Day of the Dragons leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice all Dragons you control and return all cards exiled with Day of the Dragons to the battlefield.
 When the creatures that were exiled by Day of the Dragons enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Suture Priest's first ability trigger that many times.
Resolve all Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the number of creatures that entered the battlefield.
Resolve all Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If you control eight or more nontoken creatures, this combo nets infinite life.

643-1520-1806-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies as a Vampire due to Maskwood Nexus, Timothar triggers, causing you to pay {1} and exile Eternal Scourge to create a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Bat, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

1978-3660-5149.notablePrerequisites:
Millikin does not have summoning sickness.
Power Artifact attached to Voltaic Construct.
1978-3660-5149.description:
Activate Millkin by tapping it and milling a card, adding {C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Millikin.
Repeat.

1481-2034-4881.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Swift Warkite, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Activated Sleeper by paying {2}{B}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Swift Warkite.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Activated Sleeper, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Activated Sleeper trigger, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Swift Warkite.
Repeat from step 3.

1624-3625-3646-5049.manaNeeded: {4}{G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1624-3625-3646-5049.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Redemption does not have summoning sickness.
1624-3625-3646-5049.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Storvald either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
Storvald enters the battlefield, causing Tree or Redemption's power and toughness to become one until end of turn.
Activate Tree of Redemption by tapping it, causing your life total to become one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

262-3360-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Torchling.
Torchling does not have summoning sickness.
262-3360-4289.description:
Activate Torchling by tapping it, creating three 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate an Elemental token by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Torchling's first ability by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2438-3305-4681.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2163-5065.description:
Activate Helm of Obedience by paying {1} and tapping it, causing target opponent to mill a card.
Due to Leyline of the Void's replacement effect, the milled card is exiled instead of going to the graveyard, and that opponents repeats that process until their library is empty.
